original: トムは川に飛び込んで泳ぎ始めました。

en.text: Tom jumped in the river and started swimming.

original: 彼はよくその川に泳ぎに行ったものだ。

en.text: He often went swimming in that river.

original: 夏休みは、テニスをしたり泳ぎに行ったりしてたよ。

en.text: I played tennis and went swimming during my summer vacation.
I played tennis, went swimming and did some other things during my summer vacation.

original: 自分では結構泳ぎが上手いと思っていた。

en.text: I thought that I was a fairly good swimmer.
I thought I was a fairly good swimmer.

original: ガキの頃は、よく泳ぎに行ったよ。

en.text: I went swimming a lot when I was a child.

original: 僕に泳ぎを教えてくれない？

en.text: Can you teach me how to swim?

original: 泳ぎに行きたかったな。

en.text: I wanted to go swimming.
I wish I could've gone swimming.

original: トムと一緒に泳ぎに行ってきた。

en.text: Tom and I went swimming together.
I went swimming with Tom.

original: 「泳ぎに行こうよ」「あほか？」

en.text: "Let's go for a swim." "Are you crazy?"

original: 泳ぎは心得ていますよ。

en.text: We know how to swim.

original: 泳ぎに行ってもいい？

en.text: Is it OK if I go swimming?
May I go swimming?

original: 僕は泳ぎは得意じゃないんだ。

en.text: I'm not a great swimmer.

original: 泳ぎは得意？

en.text: Are you able to swim well?

original: 泳ぎに行きたいな。

en.text: I want to go swimming.
I want to go swimming!
I want to go swimming so much!

original: めっちゃ、泳ぎに行きたい！

en.text: I want to go swimming so much!
